student_learning_goal: I can build a frequency table with qualitative or quantitative data.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can build a frequency table with qualitative or quantitative data.
header.character_watermark: Tally with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 6 survey questions as QUAL (words) or QUANT (numbers).

image_placeholders.description: Six survey questions for Grade 3 worksheet, B&W line art. Each question with QUAL/QUANT checkboxes. Examples: 'Favourite drink' (qual), 'Number of pets' (quant), 'Eye colour' (qual), 'Hours of TV' (quant), 'Favourite season' (qual), 'Number of siblings' (quant).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_SORT at Part 1: keywords name the categories.

parts.answer_key: Drink: QUAL. Pets: QUANT. Eye colour: QUAL. TV: QUANT. Season: QUAL. Siblings: QUANT.

parts.student_instructions: Use the tally chart to build a frequency table.

image_placeholders.description: A tally chart and blank frequency table for Grade 3 worksheet. Tally chart shows hockey 12, soccer 8, baseball 6, football 4. Right: blank frequency table for the child to fill in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_BUILD at Part 2: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.visual_layout: Two labelled lines for the child to write a qualitative survey question and a quantitative survey question.

image_placeholders.description: Two labelled lines for Grade 3 worksheet. 'My QUAL question: ___' and 'My QUANT question: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_SURVEY at Part 3: keyword names the activity (question).

parts.answer_key: Any valid pair of survey questions.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, give 1 question that could be either type.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Use Part 1 as formative.
